name: Fredoka
summary: Google Fonts specimen page for Fredoka, a big, round, bold sans-serif for headlines, with variable width and weight.
description: Specimen page for the Fredoka family on Google Fonts. Described as a big, round, bold font for headlines and large text, with the Latin component designed by Milena Brandão and a later Hebrew component by Ben Nathan. Released as a variable font with width and weight axes (wdth 75-125, wght 300-700); coverage includes Hebrew, Latin and Latin Extended. Source: github.com/hafontia-zz/Fredoka-One.
contains: big, round, bold sans-serif for headlines and large text
Latin component by Milena Brandão, Hebrew component by Ben Nathan
variable font with width and weight axes
Hebrew, Latin and Latin Extended subsets
